references.text: The same angel of God who spoke to Jacob in a dream now manifests physically to bless and protect him on his journey home.
Parallel between Jacob's encounter with angels before conflict and Jesus' reception of angelic strength in Gethsemane; both show God's protection in times of crisis.
Contrast between the Lord's angel who pursues enemies in the Psalms and meets Jacob with blessing; shows the different roles of angels.
Typological parallel: The Lord's angel calls to Abraham and Jacob at key moments, both responding with full obedience ('Here I am').
